forward: Execute five tests, requiring every assertion to hold. Independent trial division produces full small-number prime multisets; known full-width factorizations and exact u128 reconstruction cover larger cases. The modular step is compared to repeated modular addition, independent of multiplication.
inverse: Over terminating candidate implementations and pass/fail observations, exclude pass when any assertion fails and failure when all assertions hold. Nontermination and abort are outside this binary observation domain.

Pass reconstructs the set of implementations agreeing on every observed fixture; off-fixture behavior is unconstrained. Failure reconstructs implementations or incorrect oracle premises that cause a mismatch, not a unique defect.

limitations: Finite observations are not a universal proof.
